                    for w in adj[u]:
                        if w not in dist:
                            dist[w]=dist[u]+1; parent[w]=u
                            q.append(w)
                        elif parent[u]!=w and dist[w]>=dist[u]:
                            g=min(g,dist[u]+dist[w]+1)
            return g
